originality.rationale: The October 2026 full paper gives deterministic worst-case two-alternative interval optimization but not the i.i.d. random-threshold distribution, universal feasibility probability, biased Gaussian regime or critical Brownian window. The April 2026 unanimity paper gives elicitation algorithms. The closest observed local claim treats a worst-case limited-query regret trichotomy, logically distinct from full-information stochastic optimal violations. Random-walk reflection and invariance principles are known; the new claim is the exact social-choice stochastic specialization, not those tools themselves.
